rows.Detail: Wave boundary, confirmed (GAP-0292; D-RCV-60): a wave starts at the first release of its first epic (Wave 2 at E2, Wave 3 at E4, Wave 4 at E6). The eight monthly releases and their dates are kept; E2 and E3 are not merged.

Wave 0, confirmed (GAP-0293; D-RCV-60): the Wave 0 row of the Waves sheet, with its entry and exit criteria, is part of this plan. It is owned by the platform epics RWB-PLT-TPL, RWB-PLT-LIB, RWB-PLT-WF, RWB-PLT-DB, RWB-PLT-EVT, RWB-PLT-EDGE and RWB-PLT-OBS. Wave 0 completes before the E1 go decision, 27 November 2026 (tentative).

Wave release calendar (GAP-0300; D-RCV-60): Wave 1 is released on 30 November 2026 (tentative) with E1; Wave 2 on 31 December 2026 (tentative) with E2; Wave 3 on 28 February 2027 (tentative) with E4; Wave 4 on 30 April 2027 (tentative) with E6. Wave 0 has no release of its own and completes before the E1 go decision. These dates are under change control with DL34.

One wave per release (GAP-0301; D-RCV-60): each release belongs to one wave only, and no two waves share a release. Order of services inside a wave (Cutover and Go Live Plan v4 section 10.4): Wave 1: P4, P1, P3, P7, P5, P6, P9, P2, P10. Wave 2: S8, P8, S2, S5. Wave 3: S1, S3, S4, S6. Wave 4: S7, S9. The wave mapping and the order are under change control with DL34.

Realigned story counts (GAP-0295; D-RCV-60), from Service Story Catalog v1, by release: E1 307, E2 236, E3 81, E4 106, E5 55, E6 85, E7 49, E8 87; 28 stories carry no release; total 1,034. These supersede the 'Counts' note of the Releases sheet on restatement. The Features and Stories columns of the Releases sheet stay as the version 4 legacy baseline. Realigned feature counts: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0295). The 'Delivered in' text of Modules by release stays as the version 4 baseline.

Release ownership (GAP-0296; D-RCV-60): the accountable role for the release readiness of each wave (Wave 0 to Wave 4) is the Release owner. The delivery owners are the service owner codes of the wave: Wave 1: P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P9, P10; Wave 2: P8, S2, S5, S8; Wave 3: S1, S3, S4, S6; Wave 4: S7, S9; Wave 0: the platform epics of rule 13. No person is named. The release record and DL48 carry the same role.
